m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Oh Master, I've heard of this place. The Ancient Qhats hid their darkest secrets here - things they wanted no one to ever know about.
Oh Master, I had a funny thought. Usually, it's the books that teach us, but this time it was the opposite - we taught the Tomes a lesson. Haha!
Hm. The Spirit of Inquiry? Guess they didn't want anyone coming here with questions... like we're doing...
Any questions? Hehe. Then I guess we can move on.
Hehehe! The Ancient Ones wanted to pose the ultimate question - if you seal a Qhat in a box, without going in, how do you know if he's dead or alive?
Hehe! The answer is so simple, of course, as long as you understand quantum mechanics - the Qhat is both alive and dead at the same time! Hehe!
Now, you've entered the box and messed up everything. This is forbidden knowledge, of course. You'll have to join us now! Hehe!
Do you understand what he was talking about? I'm still trying to wrap my head around that one.
Oh, but look! There's the Eerem Tablet. Let's get it and take it back to Sandiago.
Welcome back. I trust the Ruins of Catstantinople were an educational experience. You have the Eerem Tablet?
All right, Istar. If I can recall any knowledge of value, you are welcome to it.
Excellent! We're wondering if you might know the secret to visiting the Astral Plane of the Djinn, Eerem Palace.
Eerem Palace? Why in the blazing sands would you want to go there? Wait a minute... you're a Djinni - don't you know the way?
No. Only the Senior Djinn are told the secret... I don't know why they make it such a big deal. Well, maybe so they can betray everyone. You see, I...
All right. Very well. I don't need details. The legend of Eerem Palace is as old as the Djinn themselves. These days, its secrets are lost.
The Ancient Qhats knew such secrets, however, and inscribed them on the Eerem Tablet which is said to be hidden in the Hall of Secrets.
Go to the Ruins of Catstantinople beneath Istanboa and search the Hall of Secrets. If you find the Tablet, I will translate the inscription.
There are many mysteries in the Ruins of Catstantinople. I hope you find what you're looking for, Wanderer.
